claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to apply, especially compared to glue-on lashes.
Many reviewers praise the strong hold and long wear, though some report the corners or ends lifting over time.
Several reviewers note that the eyeliner must be fully dry before applying and that the liner can be runny or lower quality.
Reviewers appreciate the variety of styles and lengths and consider the kit good value.
Some reviewers find the product did not work for them or came loose during the day.
